name: PixooPal
description: PixooPal is a server-side clockface engine for your Divoom Pixoo 64.

ports.name: Divoom MITM HTTPS Port
ports.description: HTTPS port used by app.divoom-gz.com DNS redirection. Pixoo expects this to be reachable as port 443.

ports.name: Embedded MQTT Broker Port
ports.description: PixooPal embedded MQTT broker. Pixoo expects MQTT on port 1883.

variables.name: HTTP_PORT
variables.description: Container HTTP port PixooPal listens on. Keep this aligned with the WebUI container port unless you know you need to change it.

variables.name: HTTPS_PORT
variables.description: Container HTTPS port PixooPal listens on using the bundled app.divoom-gz.com certificate.

variables.name: Pixoo Device Address
variables.description: Pixoo host or IP address on your local network.

variables.name: PixooPal Host IP
variables.description: PixooPal host IP returned to Pixoo from /Device/InitV2. Must be reachable from the Pixoo device; MQTT always uses port 1883.

variables.name: Resolution
variables.description: PixooPal render resolution. Supported values are 16, 32, and 64. Lower values can improve render and push performance.

variables.name: Home Assistant URL
variables.description: Home Assistant Address:Port, for example 192.168.1.5:8123. If only an IP is provided, PixooPal uses port 8123.

variables.name: Home Assistant Token
variables.description: Long-lived Home Assistant access token. Generate one from Security tab in your profile.

variables.name: Debug Logging
variables.description: Set to true to include additional queue, clockface, and Pixoo command diagnostics in logs.

variables.name: Disable mDNS Discovery
variables.description: Set to true to disable PixooPal mDNS/Bonjour discovery announcements.
